name: Shearline Hair Studio
tagline: Unhurried cuts, color, and styling, one client at a time.
about: Shearline Hair Studio is a fictional salon created to demonstrate an online booking and voice receptionist product. Its location, staff, prices, and policies are sample data, and no real salon services are offered.
address: 200 Sample Avenue, Los Angeles, CA (fictional address)

hair_lengths.label: Short
hair_lengths.description: Above the ears or a crop

hair_lengths.label: Extensions or very thick hair
hair_lengths.description: Extensions, or very long and thick hair. A stylist consults with you before booking.

services.name: Haircut
services.description: Wash, cut, and blow-dry, styled to your request.

services.name: All-Over Color
services.description: Single-process color from roots to ends, with a blow-dry finish.

services.name: Beard Trim
services.description: Beard shape-up and neckline clean-up, with no haircut.

faqs.question: How do I choose my hair length?
faqs.answer: Pick the length your hair is now, not the length you want. Short is above the ears, medium is chin to shoulder, and long is past the shoulders.

faqs.question: Do you work with extensions?
faqs.answer: Yes, but extensions and very thick hair need a consultation with a stylist before booking, so please request a callback.

faqs.question: Are the prices final?
faqs.answer: The listed prices are indicative demo prices that depend on your hair length. This is a demonstration, so no payment is taken.

faqs.question: Do I need a patch test before color?
faqs.answer: If you have never had color with us, or you have sensitive skin or allergies, please request a callback so a stylist can talk you through a patch test first.

faqs.question: How do I change or cancel a booking?
faqs.answer: Please contact the salon using the details on this page. Bookings can't be changed or cancelled online.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: This is a demonstration site. No payment is taken and no real appointment takes place.
